$comment: Newest first. Read by agents (agentcms status) to tell users what changed and what to run. `breaking`: an older admin, skill or site setup stops working without action. `actions`: steps a hosted site needs after updating — deploy-admin, regenerate-all, sync-theme-assets. Keep every entry in English.

changes: First release as the agentcms npm package and Claude Code plugin.
agentcms serve runs the admin on your computer to start the setup wizard without cloning the repo.

Pluggable data backends (SQLite file, Markdown in git, Firebase, Flexweg SQLite, this browser) and publish targets (GitHub, GitLab and Cloudflare Pages, S3-compatible buckets, Flexweg, own server via PHP bridge, local folder, ZIP).
